The '''Black Belt''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Belt]]. It is the upgraded form of the {{Item|Brown Belt}}.

== Obtaining ==
The '''Black Belt''' can be obtained from {{NPCSprite|Master Tao}} after reaching 7000 points in the {{zone|Dojo}}. It is automatically {{DG|Soulbound}} upon receiving it.
